title: Megurine Luka — Resonating Roughly But Richly〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here you are, Luka.
Pancakes with plenty of whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow! This is what An and the others ordered? Thank you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Without further ado♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mmm! This is delicious!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, would you like some?
It's really yummy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, please do.
Especially since you put on such a lovely performance for us just now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That really was a fun little session!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, what you said was so touching.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What I said?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember? You said...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, all we did was express how we felt. The rest was all you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can guarantee that because we've been watching over all of you for so long now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe you were able to say that because you've been watching over them this whole time, including when they discovered their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I could've said the same thing, but it would've sounded completely different.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't that because of how you behave on a day-to-day basis?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, I was trying to praise you. Or... Is this you feeling a little embarrassed?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, I think you've had your fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sob*
MEIKO... Miku's not playing along...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're free to chat all you like, but you should eat your pancakes while they're warm. Also, the whipped cream is starting to melt.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh no! You're right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mmmm! So good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, when are Kohane and the others having their event? Would it be possible for us to go see it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's supposed to be pretty soon...
But we may want to stay home for this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. This event seems to mean quite a lot to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd rather have them focus on their performance as opposed to us or anything else.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was hoping to watch Kohane lead off as the opening act...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But they should be able to record everything, so we can watch it together afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! I completely forgot!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how she does!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is just my gut instinct, but I have a feeling that the current Kohane is going to put on a spectacular performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The current Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, the way she sensed what we were thinking... I also felt something very special when we were singing together just now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
She always seems to surprise us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Every time we meet, it's like she's discovered something new in the interim. She just keeps growing, changing and finding things that are precious to her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's like the pancakes you make, MEIKO. They get better and better each time you eat them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? But I haven't changed the recipe for them in quite some time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, this could be just another one of Luka's ideas...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. True.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? Did you two just say something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, nothing.
MEIKO, can I have a cafe au lait?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like a refill of black coffee as well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. Coming right up.
